stem: Held material is accidentally staged beside normal receiving containers. What should Technician I do?
choices: Mix the containers so records match the staging
Restore the supplied segregation/hold control, document the deviation and escalate as required
Ignore it if contact was brief
rationale: Restore the supplied segregation/hold control, document the deviation and escalate as required. This preserves the Course 006 safety, postharvest, traceability, contamination-control, authority or record-quality principle being assessed.
